email.verify.subject: Confirm your email for {product}
email.verify.body:
Hi {name},

Confirm your email address by opening this link:
{link}

The link expires in 3 days. If you didn't create a {product} account, you can ignore this email.
email.reset.subject: Reset your {product} password
email.reset.body:
Hi {name},

Someone asked to reset your {product} password. To choose a new one, open this link:
{link}

The link expires in 1 hour and works once. If it wasn't you, ignore this email; your password stays the same.
email.invite.subject: {inviter} invited you to {org} on {product}
email.invite.body:
Hi,

{inviter} invited you to join {org} on {product} as {role}.

Accept the invitation:
{link}

The invitation expires in 7 days.
email.cost80.subject: {org}: 80% of this month's {product} usage limit reached
email.cost80.body:
Hi,

{org} has used ${spend} of its ${ceiling} monthly limit for automatic checks and AI analysis on {product}.

Everything keeps running for now. At 100%, scheduled checks pause until next month or until the limit is raised. To raise it, reply to this email or contact us.
email.cost100.subject: {org}: monthly {product} usage limit reached, scheduled checks paused
email.cost100.body:
Hi,

{org} has used ${spend} of its ${ceiling} monthly limit on {product}.

Scheduled ranking and AI checks are paused until next month. Actions you start yourself (like a diagnosis) still work up to 120% of the limit. To raise the limit, reply to this email or contact us.
